Fit a SuSiE-OUT model averaged over local nuisance states

Source: R/nuisance_grid.R
susieout_fit_nuisance_grid.Rd

This post-lock extension gives each locus an explicit spike at zero dense variance and positive infinitesimal/mismatch alternatives. Conditional fits are averaged using a covariance-comparable posterior expected-likelihood score, so a global nuisance estimate need not be imposed on candidate-complete sparse loci.

Usage

susieout_fit_nuisance_grid(
  z,
  n,
  R_analysis,
  wgs_ld = NULL,
  examined_ids = NULL,
  effect_prior = "robust_mixture",
  L = 10L,
  count_prior = susieout_count_prior(),
  infinitesimal_grid = c(0, 0.002, 0.008, 0.032),
  ld_mismatch_grid = c(0, 0.04, 0.12),
  infinitesimal_prior = NULL,
  ld_mismatch_prior = NULL,
  nuisance_prior = NULL,
  trained_prior = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

z, n, R_analysis, wgs_ld, examined_ids, effect_prior, L, count_prior

Arguments passed to susieout_fit().

infinitesimal_grid

Grid of total local infinitesimal variances.

ld_mismatch_grid

Grid of independent mismatch variances.

infinitesimal_prior

Optional prior weights over the dense grid.

ld_mismatch_prior

Optional prior weights over the mismatch grid.

nuisance_prior

Optional learned joint grid prior returned by susieout_train_nuisance_grid().

trained_prior

Optional frozen prior; its nuisance values are replaced by each grid point without modifying the original object.

...

Further arguments passed to susieout_fit().

Value

An susieout_fit whose PIPs and locus quantities are averaged over the nuisance grid. diagnostics$nuisance_grid contains conditional scores and posterior weights.
